6 inches is a myth 📏

The biggest review ever, 17 studies and 15,521 men measured by health professionals, found the real average is 13.1 cm, about 5.2 inches.

The twist: lots of men who are totally average think they're below average. Doctors call it small penis anxiety. Most guys who worry are completely normal.

Sources: BJU International (Veale et al. 2015) via King's College London, WBUR.
